context.description: Status check name that should be required.

appID.description: GitHub App ID that must set the status check. When omitted, any app can provide the required status check.

action.description: Which action to take. Default log; other options include issue.

enforceBranches.description: Map of repositories to lists of branches. Non-default branches where the policy is enforced (for example, release branches).

requireApproval.description: Enforce approval on pull requests. When false, approvalCount is always zero.

requireCodeOwnerReviews.description: Enforce code owner reviews on pull requests. If true, requireApproval must also be true.

approvalCount.description: Number of required pull request approvals.

dismissStale.description: Require approvals to be dismissed when a pull request is updated.

requireUpToDateBranch.description: Require that branches are up to date before merging. Used only if requireStatusChecks is set.

requireStatusChecks.description: List of status checks required to merge into the protected branch. Each entry specifies a context, and optionally an appID.

enforceOnAdmins.description: Apply branch protection rules to administrators as well.

requireSignedCommits.description: Require signed commits on protected branches.

action.description: Override for org-level action when present.

enforceDefault.description: Override for org-level enforceDefault when present.

enforceBranches.description: Additional branches to enforce beyond the org-level list. Does not override the org list.

requireApproval.description: Override for org-level requireApproval when present.

requireCodeOwnerReviews.description: Override for org-level requireCodeOwnerReviews when present.

approvalCount.description: Override for org-level approvalCount when present.

dismissStale.description: Override for org-level dismissStale when present.

blockForce.description: Override for org-level blockForce when present.

enforceOnAdmins.description: Override for org-level enforceOnAdmins when present.

requireUpToDateBranch.description: Override for org-level requireUpToDateBranch when present.

requireStatusChecks.description: Override for org-level requireStatusChecks. Omitting takes org-level as is; an empty list overrides to empty.

requireSignedCommits.description: Override for org-level requireSignedCommits when present.

OrgOptConfig.description: OptConfig contains the opt in/out configuration.

DisableRepoOverride.description: DisableRepoOverride : set to true to disallow repos from opt-in/out in their config.

OptOutForkedRepos.description: OptOutForkedRepos : set to true to opt-out forked repositories.

OptOutArchivedRepos.description: OptOutArchivedRepos : set to true to opt-out archived repositories.

OptOutPublicRepos.description: OptOutPublicRepos : set to true to not access public repos.

OptOutPrivateRepos.description: OptOutPrivateRepos : set to true to not access private repos.

OptOutRepos.description: OptOutRepos is the list of repos to opt-out when in opt-out strategy.

OptInRepos.description: OptInRepos is the list of repos to opt-in when in opt-in strategy.

OptOutStrategy.description: OptOutStrategy : set to true to change from opt-in to opt-out.

optIn.description: Opt in this repository when the organization uses opt-in strategy.

optOut.description: Opt out this repository when the organization uses opt-out strategy.

BaseConfig.description: The GitHub owner/repository containing the base configuration. The file at the same path is merged first, then values in this file override it. See https://github.com/ossf/allstar#org-level-base-and-merge-configuration-location.
